name: repertoire
description: Skills for coding agents: worktrees beside the checkout, reviewer lenses mined from a repo's own review history, data told so a reader gets the point and can act on it, and prose written by Strunk's rules.

plugins.name: sidework
plugins.description: Run Claude Code tasks in git worktrees beside the main checkout (../<repo>-sidework-<session>) instead of nested inside it.

plugins.name: build-review-lens
plugins.description: Mine a repository's review history into a reviewer lens skill that reviews your branch the way its maintainer will, before the PR opens.

plugins.name: data-story
plugins.description: Turn numbers into a point a reader gets in seconds and can act on: the questions from Storytelling with Data, then the form, the clutter cut, the emphasis on the point, and the conclusion in words.

plugins.name: write-with-style
plugins.description: Write and edit prose by Strunk's The Elements of Style (1918): the point first, a topic sentence to open each paragraph, definite sentences in the active voice, and no needless words.
